contact.faqTitle: Everything you want to know about Savvy World
contact.faqLead: Quick answers before you reach out
contact.faqAnswer1: Savvy World is a Saudi consulting and technology platform that helps companies adopt industrial robotics, responsible AI, and green energy solutions  aligned with Vision 2030.
contact.faqAnswer2: It provides indoor and outdoor digital display screens operating 24/7, along with advanced immersive content using 3D and AR technologies, featuring smart targeting and precise interaction measurement.
contact.faqAnswer3: Mr.savvy is a humanoid robot introduced in Saudi Arabia as an ambassador for good technologies and sustainability. Its main idea is to simplify the world of robotics and AI for people in a fun, easy way, available in both Arabic and English.
contact.faqQuestion4: What is the role of Savvy Expo?
contact.faqAnswer4: Savvy Expo is the events and exhibitions arm of Savvy World. Its main role is to transform any event into an intelligent, engaging, and educational experience using robotics, AI, and interactive content.
contact.faqQuestion5: Do you offer green energy solutions?
contact.faqAnswer5: Yes  comprehensively and clearly. In collaboration with the Saudi Green Building Forum, we provide fully certified green solutions. We offer it as a complete 'Green Transformation Journey' for developers, companies, and banks with profitable business models.
contact.faqAnswer6: Savvy Innovation links AI, digital interaction, and green solutions to develop more sustainable urban spaces, providing solutions geared toward the future of cities and experiences.

robotAcquisition.sectionTitle: Tell us about your robotics needs
robotAcquisition.intro:
Goals for acquiring a robot vary widely—much like choosing a vehicle, from compact cars to heavy trucks.

The clearer you are about your goal, the better we can help.

Tell us:
Is it for entertainment? Marketing? Technical or research use? Industrial? Educational? Or something else?

Also:
Do you have specific technical requirements—such as movement, artificial intelligence, or the operating environment?

The more we know, the faster we can route your request to the right team and offer the best solution.

responsibleUse.title: Intellectual Property & Responsible Robot Operation Notice
responsibleUse.ipContent: All intellectual property related to the robots, including mechanical design, software, control systems, and media materials, remains the property of their respective manufacturers and technology partners.
responsibleUse.operationContent:
Robots such as Unitree R1 and Unitree H2 are advanced robotic systems that operate through a remote controller or dedicated software interface. All movements, behaviors, or actions performed by the robot are the result of commands issued by the user or operator.

Therefore, the user or operator assumes full responsibility for the operation of the robot and for any movement or action performed during its use.
requirementsList: Understand how to properly control the robot before operating it.
Operate the robot only in safe and suitable environments.
Avoid any use that may cause harm to people or property.
Refrain from performing dangerous or unauthorized modifications.
responsibleUse.safetyContent: We place strong emphasis on product safety and information security, and we welcome feedback and suggestions that help us continuously improve.
notesList: The robots have undergone extensive testing procedures.
Features and specifications may vary depending on model or version.
The humanoid robotics industry is still in an early stage of global development.
Individual users are encouraged to fully understand the capabilities and limitations of humanoid robots before purchasing or operating them.
Please visit the official Unitree Robotics website for detailed policies and terms.
Users must comply with local laws and regulations, including those applicable in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
